**Changelog for version 1.0.1:**

- Streamlined user workflow: removed the requirement for users to provide or see open-id/身份参数; system now handles all identity linking internally.
- Updated documentation to clarify that user identity is never requested or exposed, improving privacy and user experience.
- Removed older/unneeded sample and API service script files.
- Revised sample command usage and output formatting in documentation for clarity.
- Improved internal logic for cloud-only historical report queries; local record lookup is now fully disabled.

- Initial release of the pet litter box waste analysis skill.
- Analyzes uploaded or URL-based cat litter box videos to detect feces morphology and urine clump size for health risk alerts.
- Supports multi-cat household monitoring with structured observation reporting (not disease diagnosis).
- Enforces strict open-id (user identity) acquisition before any analysis or report query.
- Provides standardized Markdown report tables with direct links when showing historical results.
- Only queries historical data from the cloud; does not use local or session data for history.
